title.zh: 卷一 本紀第一: 太祖上
title.raw: 卷一 本紀第一: 太祖上 Volume 1 Annals 1: Taizu 1

sentences.zh: 太祖耶律阿保機上

translations.literal: Taizu Yelü Abaoji, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Taizu Yelü Abaoji, Part One

sentences.zh: 太祖大聖大明神烈天皇帝，姓耶律氏，諱億，字阿保機，小字啜裏只，契丹迭剌部霞瀨益石烈鄉耶律弭里人。

translations.literal: The Taizu, Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martial, Heavenly Emperor — surname Yelü, taboo name Yi, courtesy name Abaoji, childhood name Chuilizhi — was a native of Yelü Mili village, Xiasiyishi Lie, Dieci Department of the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu, styled the Great Sage and Bright Divine Martial Heavenly Emperor, bore the surname Yelü; his given name was Yi, his courtesy name Abaoji, and his childhood name Chuilizhi. He came from Yelü Mili in the Xiasiyishi Lie of the Khitan Dieci branch.

sentences.zh: <一>德祖皇帝長子，母曰宣簡皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: <1> He was the eldest son of Emperor Dezu; his mother was Empress Xuanjian, née Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: <1> He was the eldest son of Emperor Dezu, born to Empress Xuanjian of the Xiao clan.

sentences.zh: 唐咸通十三年生。

translations.literal: He was born in the thirteenth year of the Tang Xiantong reign.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the thirteenth year of Emperor Yizong's Xiantong era (872).

sentences.zh: 初，母夢日墮懷中，有娠。

translations.literal: At the beginning, his mother dreamed that the sun fell into her bosom, and she conceived.
translations.idiomatic: Before his birth, his mother dreamed that the sun dropped into her breast, and afterward she became pregnant.

sentences.zh: 及生，室有神光異香，體如三歲兒，即能匍匐。

translations.literal: When he was born, the room had divine light and strange fragrance; his body was like that of a three-year-old child, and he could crawl at once.
translations.idiomatic: At his birth, divine light filled the room and a strange fragrance hung in the air. His body was already like a three-year-old's, and he could crawl immediately.

sentences.zh: 祖母簡獻皇后異之，鞠為己子。

translations.literal: His grandmother, Empress Jianxian, regarded him as extraordinary and reared him as her own son.
translations.idiomatic: His grandmother Empress Jianxian took him for a prodigy and raised him as if he were her own child.

sentences.zh: 常匿於別幕，塗其面，不令他人見。

translations.literal: She often hid him in a separate tent, smeared his face, and did not allow others to see him.
translations.idiomatic: She kept him hidden in a separate tent, darkened his face with ash, and forbade anyone else to look upon him.

sentences.zh: 三月能行；

translations.literal: At three months he could walk;
translations.idiomatic: By three months he could walk;

sentences.zh: 而能言，知未然事。

translations.literal: and he could speak, and knew things before they happened.
translations.idiomatic: and soon he could speak and foretell events yet to come.

sentences.zh: 自謂左右若有神人翼衛。

translations.literal: He claimed that on his left and right there seemed to be divine beings guarding him with wings.
translations.idiomatic: He said that divine guardians seemed to hover at his sides, winged and vigilant.

sentences.zh: 雖齠齔，言必及世務。

translations.literal: Although he was still in childhood, his words always touched upon affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a child with baby teeth, he spoke always of public affairs.

sentences.zh: 時伯父當國，疑輒咨焉。

translations.literal: At that time his uncle held power over the state; whenever in doubt he would consult him.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle then governed the Khitan, and whenever uncertain he sought the boy's counsel.

sentences.zh: 既長，身長九尺，豐上銳下，目光射人，關弓三百斤。

translations.literal: When he had grown up, he stood nine chi tall, broad above and tapering below; his gaze pierced people, and he could draw a bow of three hundred jin.
translations.idiomatic: Grown to manhood, he stood nine chi in height — broad-shouldered above, lean below — with a gaze that struck men like an arrow and strength enough to draw a three-hundred-jin bow.

sentences.zh: 為撻馬沙裏。

translations.literal: He served as tamun shar.
translations.idiomatic: He held the office of tamun shar.

sentences.zh: 時小黃室韋不附，太祖以計降之。

translations.literal: At that time the Lesser Yellow Shiwei did not submit; Taizu subdued them by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: When the Lesser Yellow Shiwei refused submission, Taizu took them by strategy.

sentences.zh: 伐越兀及烏古、六奚、比沙諸部，克之。

translations.literal: He attacked the Yuewu, Wugu, Liuxi, Bisha, and other tribes, and conquered them.
translations.idiomatic: He marched against Yuewu and the Wugu, Liuxi, and Bisha tribes, among others, and brought them to heel.

sentences.zh: 國人號阿主沙裏。

translations.literal: The people of the state called him Azhu Shar.
translations.idiomatic: His countrymen gave him the name Azhu Shar.

sentences.zh: 唐天復元年，歲辛酉，痕德可汗立，以太祖為本部夷離，專征討，連破室韋、于厥及奚帥轄剌哥，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu reign, the year xinyou, Hende Khan was enthroned and appointed Taizu yilijin of the native tribe, put in charge of campaigns; he repeatedly defeated the Shiwei, Yujue, and the Xi chieftain Xialage, capturing many prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu era (901), the xinyou year, Hende Khan came to power and made Taizu yilijin of his own branch, entrusting him with military command. Taizu in succession broke the Shiwei and Yujue and the Xi leader Xialage, taking vast numbers captive.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，授大迭烈府夷離。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he was appointed yilijin of the Great Dieci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, he was given the post of yilijin of the Great Dieci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年秋七月，以兵四十萬伐河東代北，<二>攻下九郡，獲生口九萬五千，駝、馬、牛、羊不可勝紀。

translations.literal: The following year, in the seventh month of autumn, with four hundred thousand troops he attacked Hedong and the north of Dai; <2> he captured nine commanderies, taking ninety-five thousand captives, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep beyond numbering.
translations.idiomatic: The next autumn, in the seventh month, he led four hundred thousand men against Hedong and northern Dai, <2> seized nine commanderies, took ninety-five thousand captives, and won camels, horses, cattle, and sheep past all count.

sentences.zh: 九月，城龍化州於潢河之南，始建開教寺。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he walled Longhua Prefecture south of the Huang River and for the first time built Kaijiao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he fortified Longhua Prefecture on the south bank of the Huang River and founded Kaijiao Temple.

sentences.zh: 明年春，伐女直，下之，獲其戶三百。

translations.literal: The following spring, he attacked the Jurchen, subjugated them, and captured three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring he campaigned against the Jurchen, brought them down, and took three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 九月，復攻下河東懷遠等軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he again attacked and captured the Huaiyuan Army and other Hedong garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he renewed the assault on Hedong and took the Huaiyuan garrison and others.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，引軍略至薊北，俘獲以還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he led his army in a raid as far as north of Ji and returned with captives and booty.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, he pushed his forces in a foray to the north of Ji and returned laden with prisoners and plunder.

sentences.zh: 先是德祖俘奚七千戶，徙饒樂之清河，至是創為奚迭剌部，分十三縣。

translations.literal: Previously Dezu had captured seven thousand Xi households and moved them to Qinghe in Raole; at this time they were established as the Xi Dieci branch and divided into thirteen districts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Dezu had taken seven thousand Xi households and resettled them at Qinghe in Raole; now they were organized into the Xi Dieci branch, divided into thirteen counties.

sentences.zh: 遂拜太祖于越、總知軍國事。

translations.literal: Taizu was then appointed yue and given overall charge of military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu was thereupon made yue, with full authority over army and state.

sentences.zh: 明年歲甲子，三月，廣龍化州之東城。

translations.literal: The following year, the jiazi year, in the third month, the eastern wall of Longhua Prefecture was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, a jiazi year, in the third month the eastern quarter of Longhua Prefecture was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 九月，討黑車子室韋，唐盧龍軍節度使劉仁恭發兵數萬，遣養子趙霸來拒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei; Liu Rengong, Military Governor of the Tang Lulong Army, sent tens of thousands of troops and dispatched his adopted son Zhao Ba to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he marched against the Black-Cart Shiwei. Liu Rengong, Tang governor of the Lulong Army, raised tens of thousands of men and sent his adopted son Zhao Ba to meet him.

sentences.zh: 霸至武州，太祖諜知之，伏勁兵桃山下。

translations.literal: When Ba reached Wuzhou, Taizu learned of it through spies and hid crack troops below Peach Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Ba reached Wuzhou; Taizu, warned by his scouts, lay in wait with elite troops beneath Peach Mountain.

sentences.zh: 遣室韋人牟裏詐稱其酋長所遣，約霸兵會平原。

translations.literal: He sent a Shiwei man named Moli, who falsely claimed to have been sent by his chieftain, to arrange a meeting with Ba's forces on the plain.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a Shiwei named Moli to pose as an envoy from the chieftain and invite Ba's army to a rendezvous on the open plain.

sentences.zh: 既至，四面伏發，擒霸，殲其眾，乘勝大破室韋。

translations.literal: When they arrived, the hidden troops sprang up on all sides; they captured Ba, annihilated his force, and pressing the victory routed the Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: When Ba came, ambushers rose on every side. They took Ba prisoner, wiped out his army, and drove on to shatter the Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 明年七月，復討黑車子室韋。

translations.literal: The following year, in the seventh month, he again campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the seventh month, he returned to punish the Black-Cart Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 唐河東節度使李克用遣通事康令德乞盟。

translations.literal: Li Keyong, Military Governor of Hedong under the Tang, sent the interpreter Kang Lingde to request an alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong, Tang's Hedong governor, sent his interpreter Kang Lingde to sue for an alliance.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太祖以騎兵七萬會克用於雲州，宴酣，克用借兵以報劉仁恭木瓜澗之役，太祖許之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Taizu with seventy thousand cavalry met Keyong at Yunzhou; when the banquet was well underway, Keyong asked to borrow troops to avenge his defeat by Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu agreed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, Taizu brought seventy thousand horsemen to meet Keyong at Yunzhou. Over wine Keyong asked for troops to settle the score with Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu consented.

sentences.zh: 易袍馬，約為兄弟。

translations.literal: They exchanged robes and horses and pledged brotherhood.
translations.idiomatic: They exchanged cloaks and mounts and swore themselves brothers.

sentences.zh: 及進兵擊仁恭，撥數州，盡徙其民以歸。

translations.literal: When they advanced to attack Rengong, they seized several prefectures and moved all the people away with them.
translations.idiomatic: Marching on Rengong, they overran several prefectures and carried off the entire populace.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，復擊劉仁恭。

translations.literal: The following year, in the second month, they again attacked Liu Rengong.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the second month, they struck Liu Rengong once more.

sentences.zh: 還，襲山北奚，破之。

translations.literal: On the return, they raided the Xi north of the mountains and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the homeward march they fell upon the mountain-north Xi and broke them.

sentences.zh: 汴州朱全忠遣人浮海奉書幣、衣帶、珍玩來聘。

translations.literal: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou sent men by sea bearing letters, gifts, robes and belts, and precious objects to offer friendship.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou dispatched envoys by sea with letters, tribute gifts, robes, sashes, and curiosities to propose alliance.

sentences.zh: 十一月，遣偏師討奚、諸部及東北女直之未附者，悉破降之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he sent a detached force to campaign against the Xi and various tribes, and the unsubmitted Jurchen of the northeast; all were defeated and made to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he sent a subsidiary army against the Xi and allied tribes, and against Jurchen in the northeast still outside his sway; all were crushed and brought to surrender.

sentences.zh: 十二月，痕德可汗殂，群臣奉遺命請立太祖。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Hende Khan died; the ministers, obeying his final command, asked that Taizu be enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Hende Khan died. The ministers, following his dying wish, pressed Taizu to take the throne.

sentences.zh: 曷魯等勸進。

translations.literal: Helu and others urged him to accept.
translations.idiomatic: Helu and others pressed him to ascend.

sentences.zh: 太祖三讓，從之。

translations.literal: Taizu declined three times, then acquiesced.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu refused thrice before yielding to them.

sentences.zh: 元年春正月庚寅，命有司設壇于如迂王集會堝，<三>燔柴告天，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the first year, on gengyin day in the first month of spring, he ordered officials to set up an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound; <3> he burned sacrificial wood to announce Heaven and took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In his first year, on the gengyin day of the first spring month, he had officials erect an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound, <3> offered burnt sacrifices to Heaven, and ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 尊母蕭氏為皇太后，立皇后蕭氏。

translations.literal: He honored his mother, née Xiao, as Empress Dowager and installed Empress Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: He raised his mother of the Xiao clan to Empress Dowager and crowned an Empress Xiao.

sentences.zh: 北宰相蕭轄剌、南宰相耶律歐裏思率群臣上尊號曰天皇帝，後曰地皇后。

translations.literal: The Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and the Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi led the ministers in offering the honorific titles Heavenly Emperor and Earth Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi, at the head of the court, presented the elevated titles Heavenly Emperor for him and Earth Empress for her.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔皇族承遙輦氏九帳為第十帳。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, an edict proclaimed that the imperial clan would succeed the nine tents of the Yaolian clan as the tenth tent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day he decreed that the royal house should take its place as a tenth tent, succeeding the nine tents of the Yaolian line.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，以從弟迭栗底為迭烈府夷離。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the second month, he appointed his younger cousin Dielidi yilijin of the Dieci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the second month he named his cousin Dielidi yilijin of the Dieci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是月，征黑車子室韋，降其八部。

translations.literal: That month, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei and brought their eight tribes to submission.
translations.idiomatic: That same month he marched on the Black-Cart Shiwei and received the submission of all eight of their tribes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，唐梁王朱全忠廢其主，尋弑之，<四>自立為帝，國號梁，遣使來告。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the first day of the fourth month of summer, Zhu Quanzhong, Prince of Liang under the Tang, deposed his sovereign and soon killed him; <4> he declared himself emperor, taking the dynastic name Liang, and sent envoys to announce it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the fourth summer month, Zhu Quanzhong, Tang's Prince of Liang, deposed his lord and shortly afterward murdered him; <4> he proclaimed himself emperor under the name Liang and sent envoys with the news.

sentences.zh: 劉仁恭子守光囚其父，自稱幽州盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: Liu Rengong's son Shouguang imprisoned his father and styled himself Military Governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shouguang, son of Liu Rengong, locked up his father and declared himself governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，其兄平州刺史守奇率其眾數千人來降，命置之平盧城。

translations.literal: On yiyou day in the seventh month of autumn, his elder brother Shouqi, Governor of Pingzhou, led several thousand of his followers to surrender, and they were ordered settled at Pinglu City.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the seventh autumn month his elder brother Shouqi, prefect of Pingzhou, came over with several thousand men and was resettled at Pinglu City.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，討黑車子室韋，破之。

translations.literal: On yisi day in the tenth month of winter, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day that winter, in the tenth month, he attacked the Black-Cart Shiwei and broke them.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸酉朔，禦正殿受百官及諸國使朝。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the first day of the first month of spring in the second year, he received homage in the main hall from officials and envoys of various states.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the second year's first spring month, he held court in the main hall to receive the obeisance of officials and foreign envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，始置惕隱，典族屬，以皇弟撒剌為之。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, the office of tiyin was first established to oversee clan affairs, and his imperial brother Salaci was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he created the office of tiyin to govern the clans and appointed his brother Salaci to the post.

sentences.zh: 河東李克用卒，<五>子存襲，遣使吊慰。

translations.literal: Li Keyong of Hedong died; <5> his son Cunxu succeeded him, and envoys were sent to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyong of Hedong died; <5> his son Li Cunxu took his place, and Taizu sent envoys with condolences.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸酉，詔撒剌討烏丸、黑車子室韋。

translations.literal: On guiyou day in the fifth month of summer, an edict ordered Salaci to campaign against the Wuhuan and Black-Cart Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fifth summer month he commanded Salaci against the Wuhuan and the Black-Cart Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬子，幽州進合歡瓜。

translations.literal: On renzi day in the eighth month of autumn, Youzhou presented a hehuan melon.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day in the eighth autumn month, Youzhou sent tribute of a twin-fused melon.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，建明王樓。

translations.literal: On jihai, the first day of the tenth month of winter, the Bright King Tower was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the tenth winter month, he erected the Bright King Tower.

sentences.zh: 築長城於鎮東海口。

translations.literal: A long wall was built at the eastern sea mouth of Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: He constructed a long wall at Zhendong's seaward mouth.

sentences.zh: 遣輕兵取吐渾叛入室韋者。

translations.literal: Light troops were dispatched to capture Tuyuhun rebels who had fled into Shiwei territory.
translations.idiomatic: He sent light cavalry to seize Tuyuhun rebels who had crossed into Shiwei lands.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，幸遼東。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year, he visited Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year's first spring month he toured Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，梁遣郎公遠來聘。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the first day of the second month, Liang sent Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic mission.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon of the second month, Liang dispatched Lang Gongyuan as envoy.

sentences.zh: 三月，滄州節度使劉守文為弟守光所攻，遣人來乞兵討之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Liu Shouwen, Military Governor of Cangzhou, was attacked by his brother Shouguang and sent men to request troops to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Liu Shouwen, governor of Cangzhou, came under attack from his brother Shouguang and sent asking for troops to strike back.

sentences.zh: 命皇弟舍利素、夷離蕭敵魯以兵會守文於北淖口。

translations.literal: He ordered his imperial brother Sheli Su and the yilijin Xiao Dilu to lead troops to join Shouwen at Beinao Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded his brother Sheli Su and the yilijin Xiao Dilu to march and rendezvous with Shouwen at Beinao Mouth.

sentences.zh: 進至橫海軍近澱，一鼓破之，守光潰去。

translations.literal: Advancing to the marshland near the Henghai Army, they broke the enemy at the first assault and Shouguang fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing to the flats near the Henghai garrison, they shattered the foe at a single drumbeat and Shouguang broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 因名北淖口為會盟口。

translations.literal: Because of this, Beinao Mouth was renamed Alliance Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Beinao Mouth was therefore renamed Alliance Mouth.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，詔左僕射韓知古建碑龍化州大廣寺以紀功德。

translations.literal: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer, an edict ordered Left Vice Director Han Zhigu to erect a stele at the Daguan Temple of Longhua Prefecture to record meritorious deeds.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the fourth summer month he ordered Vice Premier Han Zhigu to raise a stele at Longhua Prefecture's Daguan Temple commemorating his achievements.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，置羊城於炭山之北以通市易。

translations.literal: On jiashen day in the fifth month, a sheep market was established north of Coal Mountain to facilitate trade.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the fifth month he founded a sheep market north of Coal Mountain for commerce.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，遣鷹軍討黑車子室韋，破之。

translations.literal: On jisi day in the tenth month of winter, the Hawk Army was sent to campaign against the Black-Cart Shiwei and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day that winter, in the tenth month, he sent the Hawk Army against the Black-Cart Shiwei and broke them.

sentences.zh: 西北娘改部族進挽車人。

translations.literal: The Nianggai tribe of the northwest presented ox-cart drivers as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Nianggai tribe from the northwest offered cart-drivers in tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年秋七月戊子朔，以后兄蕭敵魯為北府宰相。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the first day of the seventh month of autumn in the fourth year, his empress's elder brother Xiao Dilu was appointed Northern Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the fourth year's seventh autumn month he named the Empress's elder brother Xiao Dilu Northern Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 后族為相自此始。

translations.literal: From this time the empress's clan began to hold the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: Thus began the custom of appointing the Empress's kin as chancellor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，烏馬山奚庫支及查剌底、鋤勃德等叛，討平之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Xi chieftains Kuge, Chaladi, and Chubode of Wumashan rebelled and were suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, the Wumashan Xi leaders Kuge, Chaladi, and Chubode rose in rebellion and were put down.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the first day of the first month of spring in the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the fifth year's first spring month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上親征西部奚。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, the Emperor personally campaigned against the western Xi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor took the field in person against the western Xi.

sentences.zh: 奚阻險，叛服不常，數招諭弗聽。

translations.literal: The Xi held difficult terrain; their submission and rebellion were inconstant, and repeated summons and persuasion went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: The Xi barricaded themselves in rugged country, wavering between rebellion and submission; repeated appeals brought no answer.

sentences.zh: 是役所向輒下，遂分兵討東部奚，亦平之。

translations.literal: In this campaign wherever he went he prevailed; he then divided his forces to campaign against the eastern Xi and pacified them as well.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign he took every stronghold he met; he then split his army to subdue the eastern Xi and pacified them too.

sentences.zh: 於是盡有奚、之地。

translations.literal: Thus he came to possess all the lands of the Xi and Shiwei.
translations.idiomatic: He now held the full territory of the Xi and Shiwei.

sentences.zh: 東際海，南暨白檀，西松漠，北抵潢水，凡五部，咸入版籍。

translations.literal: It reached the sea on the east, touched Baitan on the south, Songmo on the west, and the Huang River on the north; all five divisions were entered on the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Eastward it ran to the sea, south to Baitan, west to Songmo, north to the Huang River — five divisions in all, every one entered on the tax rolls.

sentences.zh: 三月，次灤河，刻石紀功。

translations.literal: In the third month, he halted at the Luan River and carved stone to record his achievements.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he encamped on the Luan River and cut stone inscriptions to commemorate his victories.

sentences.zh: 復略地薊州。

translations.literal: He again raided the territory of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He again carried out a raid into Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，遣人使梁。

translations.literal: On renshen day in the fourth month of summer, envoys were sent to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the fourth summer month he dispatched envoys to Liang.

sentences.zh: 五月，皇弟剌葛、迭剌、寅底石、安端謀反。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, his imperial brothers Cige, Dieci, Yindishi, and Anduan plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month his brothers Cige, Dieci, Yindishi, and Anduan conspired to rebel.

sentences.zh: 安端妻粘睦姑知之，以告，得實。

translations.literal: Anduan's wife Nianmugu learned of it, reported it, and the plot was verified.
translations.idiomatic: Anduan's wife Nianmugu discovered the plot, informed the court, and the charge was proved true.

sentences.zh: 上不忍加誅，乃與諸弟登山刑牲，告天地為誓而赦其罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor could not bear to execute them; he therefore climbed a mountain with his brothers, sacrificed animals, announced Heaven and Earth as witnesses to an oath, and pardoned their crime.
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bring himself to punish them, he climbed a mountain with his brothers, offered sacrifice, swore before Heaven and Earth, and granted them pardon.

sentences.zh: 出剌葛為迭剌部夷離，封粘睦姑為晉國夫人。

translations.literal: Cige was sent out as yilijin of the Dieci branch, and Nianmugu was enfeoffed as Lady of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: He posted Cige as yilijin of the Dieci branch and ennobled Nianmugu as Lady of Jin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午朔，斜離底及諸蕃使來貢。

translations.literal: On renwu, the first day of the seventh month of autumn, Xielidi and envoys of various tribes came to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the seventh autumn month, Xielidi and tribal envoys arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，劉守光僭號幽州，稱燕。

translations.literal: On jiazi day in the eighth month, Liu Shouguang usurped title at Youzhou and styled himself Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day in the eighth month Liu Shouguang seized the imperial style at Youzhou and proclaimed the state of Yan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，置鐵冶。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the tenth month of winter, an iron foundry was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day that winter, in the tenth month, he established an iron foundry.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，遣人使梁。

translations.literal: On renwu day in the eleventh month, envoys were sent to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day in the eleventh month he again sent envoys to Liang.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月，以化葛為惕隱。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, Huage was appointed tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year's first spring month he made Huage tiyin.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，親征劉守光。

translations.literal: On wuwu day in the second month, he personally campaigned against Liu Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the second month he took the field in person against Liu Shouguang.

sentences.zh: 三月，至自幽州。

translations.literal: In the third month, he returned from Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he came back from Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁郢王友弑父自立。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, You, Prince of Ying of Liang, killed his father and declared himself ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Zhu Yougui, Liang's Prince of Ying, murdered his father and seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，親征術不姑，降之，俘獲以數萬計。

translations.literal: On bingwu day in the seventh month of autumn, he personally campaigned against Shibugu, made them submit, and took captives and booty numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day in the seventh autumn month he marched in person against Shibugu, received their surrender, and took prisoners and spoil by the tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 命弟剌葛分兵攻平州。

translations.literal: He ordered his brother Cige to divide forces and attack Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded his brother Cige to split off troops and strike Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，上次恩德山。

translations.literal: On renchen day in the eighth month, the Emperor halted at Mount Ende.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the eighth month he encamped on Mount Ende.

sentences.zh: 皇子李胡生。

translations.literal: The Prince Li Hu was born.
translations.idiomatic: The prince Li Hu was born.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，剌葛破平州，還，復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反。
甲申，遣人使梁致祭。
壬辰，還次北阿魯山，聞諸弟以兵阻道，引軍南趨十七濼。
是日燔柴。
翼日，次七渡河，諸弟各遣人謝罪。
上猶矜憐，許以自新。
是歲，以兵討兩冶，以所獲僧崇文等五十人歸西樓，建天雄寺以居之，以示天助雄武。
七年春正月甲辰朔，以用兵免朝。
晉王李存撥幽州，擒劉守光。
甲寅，王師次赤水城，弟剌葛等乞降。
上素服，乘赭白馬，以將軍耶律樂姑、轄剌僅阿缽為禦，解兵器、肅侍衛以受之，因加慰諭。
剌葛等引退，上復數遣使撫慰。
二月甲戌朔，梁均王友貞討殺其兄友，嗣立。
三月癸丑，次蘆水，弟迭剌哥圖為奚王，與安端擁千餘騎而至，紿稱入覲。
上怒曰：「爾曹始謀逆亂，朕特恕之，使改過自新，尚爾反覆，將不利於朕！
」遂拘之。
以所部分隸諸軍。
而剌葛引其眾至乙室堇澱，具天子旗鼓，將自立，皇太后陰遣人諭令避去。
會弭姑乃、懷裏陽言車駕且至，其眾驚潰，掠居民北走，上以兵追之。
剌葛遣其党寅底石引兵徑趨行宮，焚其輜重、廬帳，縱兵大殺。
皇后急遣蜀古魯救之，<六>僅得天子旗鼓而已。
其党神速姑復劫西樓，焚明王樓。
上至土河，秣馬休兵，若不為意。
諸將請急追之，上曰：「俟其遠遁，人各懷土。
懷土既切，其心必離，我軍乘之，破之必矣！
」盡以先所獲資畜分賜將士，留夷離畢直裏姑總政務。
夏四月戊寅，北追剌葛。
己卯，次弭裏，問諸弟面木葉山射鬼箭厭禳，<七>乃執叛人解裏向彼，亦以其法厭之。
至達裏澱，選輕騎追及培只河，盡獲其黨輜重、生口。
先遣室韋及吐渾酋長撥剌、迪裏姑等五人分兵伏其前路，命北宰相迪裏古為先鋒進擊之。
剌葛率兵逆戰，迪裏古以輕兵薄之。
其弟遏古只臨陣，射數十人斃，眾莫敢前。
相拒至晡，眾乃潰。
追至柴河，遂自焚其車乘廬帳而去。
前遇撥剌、迪裏姑等伏發，合擊，遂大敗之。
剌葛奔潰，遺其所奪神帳於路，上見而拜奠之。
所獲生口盡縱歸本土。
其党庫古只、磨朵皆面縛請罪。
師次劄堵河，大雨暴漲。
五月癸丑，遣北宰相迪輦率驍騎先渡。
甲寅，奏擒剌葛、涅裏袞阿缽於榆河，前北宰相蕭實魯、寅底石自剄不殊。
遂以黑白羊祭天地。
壬戌，剌葛、涅裏袞阿缽詣行在，以稿索自縛，牽羊望拜。
上還至大嶺。
時大軍久出，輜重不相屬，士卒煮馬駒、采野菜以為食，孳畜道斃者十七八，物價十倍，器服資貨委棄於楚裏河，狼藉數百里，因更剌葛名暴裏。
丙寅，至庫裏，以青牛白馬祭天地。
以生口六百、馬二千三百分賜大、小鶻軍。
六月辛巳，至榆嶺，以轄賴縣人掃古非法殘民，磔之。
甲申，上登都庵山，撫其先奇首可汗遺跡，徘徊顧瞻而興歎焉。
聞獄官涅離擅造大校，人不堪其苦，有至死者，命誅之。
壬辰，次狼河，獲逆黨雅裏、弭裏，生埋之銅河南軌下。
放所俘還，多為於骨裏所掠。
上怒，引輕騎馳擊。
復遣驍將分道追襲，盡獲其眾並掠者。
庚子，次阿敦濼，以養子涅裏思附諸弟叛，以鬼箭射殺之。
其餘黨六千，各以輕重論刑。
於厥掠生口者三十餘人，亦俾贖其罪，放歸本部。
至石嶺西，詔收回軍乏食所棄兵仗，召北府兵驗而還之。
以夷離涅裏袞附諸弟為叛，不忍顯戮，命自投崖而死。
秋八月己卯，幸龍眉宮，逆黨二十九人，以其妻女賜有功將校，所掠珍寶、孳畜還主；
亡其本物者，命責償其家；
不能償者，賜以其部曲。
九月壬戌，上發自西樓。
冬十月庚午。
駐赤崖。
戊寅，和州回鶻來貢。
癸未，乙室府人迪裏古、迷骨離部人特裏以從逆誅。
詔群臣分決滯訟，以韓知古錄其事，只裏姑掌捕亡。
十一月，祠木葉山。
還次昭烏山，省風俗，見高年，議朝政，定吉凶儀。
十二月戊子，燔柴於蓮花濼。
八年春正月甲辰，以曷魯為迭剌部夷離，忽烈為惕隱。
於骨裏部人特離敏執逆党怖胡、亞裏只等十七人來獻，上親鞫之。
辭多連宗室及有脅從者，乃杖殺首惡怖胡，餘並原釋。
於越率懶之子化哥屢蓄奸謀，上每優容之，而反覆不悛，召父老群臣正其罪，並其子戮之，分其財以給衛士。
有司所鞫逆黨三百餘人，獄既具，上以人命至重，死不復生，賜宴一日，隨其平生之好，使為之。
酒酣，或歌、或舞、或戲射、角，各極其意。
明日，乃以輕重論刑。
首惡剌葛，其次迭剌哥，上猶弟之，不忍置法，杖而釋之。
以寅底石、安端性本庸弱，為剌葛所使，皆釋其罪。
前于越赫底裏子解裏、剌葛妻轄剌已實預逆謀，命皆絞殺之。
寅底石妻涅離脅從，安端妻粘睦姑嘗有忠告，並免。
因謂左右曰：「諸弟性雖敏黠，而蓄奸稔惡。
嘗自矜有出人之智，安忍凶狠，溪壑可塞而貪黷無厭。
求人之失，雖小而可恕，謂重如泰山；
身行不義，雖入大惡，謂輕於鴻毛。
昵比群小，謀及婦人，同惡相濟，以危國祚。
雖欲不敗，其可得乎？
北宰相實魯妻餘盧睹姑於國至親，一旦負朕，從於叛逆，未置之法而病死。
此天誅也。
解裏自幼與朕常同寢食，眷遇之厚，冠於宗屬，亦與其父背大恩而從不軌，茲可恕乎！」
秋七月丙申朔，有司上諸帳族與謀逆者三百餘人罪狀，皆棄市。
上歎曰：「致人於死，豈朕所欲。
若止負朕躬，尚可容貸。
此曹恣行不道，殘害忠良，塗炭生民，剽掠財產。
民間昔有萬馬，今皆徒步，有國以來所未嘗有。
實不得已而誅之。」
冬十月甲子朔，建開皇殿於明王樓基。
九年春正月，烏古部叛，討平之。
夏六月，幽州軍校齊行本舉其族及其部曲男女三千人請降，詔授檢校尚書、左僕射，賜名兀欲，給其堿食。
數日亡去，幽帥周德威納之。
及詔索之，德威語不遜，乃議南征。
冬十月戊申，鉤魚于鴨淥江。
新羅遣使貢方物，高麗遣使進寶劍，吳越王錢遣滕彥休來貢。
是歲，君基太一神數見，詔圖其像。
三月丙辰，以迭烈部夷離曷魯為阿廬朵裏於越，百僚進秩、頒賚有差，賜三日。
立子倍為皇太子。
夏四月乙酉朔，晉幽州節度使盧國用來降，<八>以為幽州兵馬留後。
甲辰，梁遣郎公遠來賀。
六月庚寅，吳越王遣滕彥休來貢。
秋七月壬申，親征突厥、吐渾、項、小蕃、沙陀諸部，皆平之。
俘其酋長及其戶萬五千六百，鎧甲、兵仗、器服九十餘萬，寶貨、駝馬、牛羊不可勝算。
八月，撥朔州，擒節度使李嗣本。
勒石紀功於青塚南。
冬十月癸未朔，乘勝而東。
十一月，攻蔚、新、武、媯、儒五州，斬首萬四千七百餘級。
自代北至河曲陰山，盡有其地。
遂改武州為歸化州，媯州為可汗州，置西南面招討司，選有功者領之。
其圍蔚州，敵樓無故自壞，眾軍大噪乘之，不時而破。
時梁及吳越二使皆在焉，詔引環城觀之，因賜滕彥休名曰逑呂。
十二月，收山北八軍。
二年春二月，晉新州裨將盧文進殺節度使李存榘來降。
進攻其城，刺史安金全遁，以文進部將劉殷為刺史。
三月辛亥，攻幽州，節度使周德威以幽、并、鎮、定、魏五州之兵拒於居庸關之西，合戰於新州東，大破之，斬首三萬餘級，殺李嗣恩之子武八。
<九>以后弟阿骨只為統軍，實魯為先鋒，東出關略燕、趙，不遇敵而還。
己未，於骨裏叛，命室魯以兵討之。
夏四月壬午，圍幽州，不克。
六月乙巳，望城中有氣如煙火狀，上曰：「未可攻也。
」以大暑霖潦，班師。
留曷魯、盧國用守之。
剌葛與其子賽保裏叛入幽州。
秋八月，李存遣李嗣源等救幽州，曷魯等以兵少而還。
三年春正月丙申，以皇弟安端為大內惕隱，命攻雲州及西南諸部。
二月，達旦國來聘。
癸亥，城皇都，以禮部尚書康默記充版築使。
梁遣使來聘。
晉、吳越、渤海、高麗、回鶻、阻卜、項及幽、鎮、定、魏、潞等州各遣使來貢。
夏四月乙巳，皇弟迭烈哥謀叛，事覺，知有罪當誅，預為營壙，而諸戚請免。
上素惡其弟寅底石妻涅裏袞，乃曰：「涅裏袞能代其死，則從。
」涅裏袞自縊壙中，並以奴女古、叛人曷魯只生瘞其中。
遂赦迭烈哥。
五月乙亥，詔建孔子廟、佛寺、道觀。
校勘記
一：霞瀨益石烈張元濟校勘記
（以下稱張校）〉
引百官志一「石烈，縣也」，百官志二「弭裏，鄉也」，謂石烈下不應綴鄉字。
按國語解又以石烈為鄉，弭裏為鄉之小者。
石烈鄉，鄉字亦復贅。
檢下文太祖七年六月轄賴縣、營衛志下六院部轄懶石烈，均此名異譯。
鄉字衍。
二：伐河東代北代北，原誤「伐北」，據兵衛志上及永樂大典
（道光殿本考證引）〉
改。
三：如迂王集會堝紀太宗天顯五年十月作如迂正集會堝。
四：夏四月丁未朔唐梁王朱全忠廢其主尋弑之錢大昕廿二史考異
（以下稱考異）〉
引歐陽修五代史記
（以下稱新五代史）〉
，梁王即位在四月甲子，明年正月「弑濟陰王」。
此系之四月朔，誤。
五：河東李克用卒卒字，據張校補。
六：皇后急遣蜀古魯救之蜀古魯，儀衛志四作曷古魯，是。
七：問諸弟面木葉山射鬼箭厭禳馮家升遼史初校
（以下稱馮校）〉
云：問當作聞。
八：晉幽州節度使盧國用來降按此為次年二月盧文進來降之重出。
考異又論是時幽州節度使為周德威，不能同時又是盧國用。
因文進為契丹平州節度使，遂誤以契丹所授之官為唐官。
輯本薛居正五代史
（以下稱舊五代史）〉
九七文進字國用，新五代史四八作大用。
九：李嗣恩之子武八嗣恩，原誤「嗣本」。
按新、舊五代史李嗣本傳均不稱有子武八。
檢舊五代史五二李嗣恩傳：「有子二人，長曰武八┅┅戰契丹於新州，歿焉。
」據改。
